herec_1.m: Welcome, traveller. You must be the one I heard about, that travelled up the mountain.

herec_10.m: Good. Thank you. Please hurry back so I can continue my research on these beasts.

herec_11.m: I assure you that my research is important. But it's your decision, and your loss.

herec_2.m: Would you be willing to help me with a task?
r: Why would I want to help you?

herec_3.m: Ah, a negotiator. I like that. If you help me, I will offer to trade the fruits of my labour with you. It should be most valuable to you.
r: Fine. What task are we talking about here?
No, how can I agree to something when I don't know what it is? I'm out.

herec_4.m: It is simple really. I am studying these wyrm creatures that lurk outside our settlement. I am trying to find what their strengths are, so that I can use it for myself.

herec_5.m: But my expertise is in the studies of them, and not in actually going head to head with those things.

herec_7.m: I need you to gather some samples from them for me. I hear that some of the white wyrm beasts have sharper claws that can be extracted at the time of death.

herec_8.m: If you were to bring me some samples of those claws from the white wyrms, that would really speed up my research further.

herec_9.m: Let's say, five of those claws should be enough.
r: OK, sounds easy enough. I'll get you your 5 white wyrm claws.
Sure. Those things are no match for me.
No way I am going near those beasts again.

herec_q1.m: Welcome back. How is the search going?
r: What was I supposed to do again?
I haven't found everything yet. But I am working on it.
I have found what you asked for.

herec_q2.m: Very well done my friend! These will be very valuable in my research.

herec_q2_2.m: Come back in just a minute and I will have something ready for you.

herec_q3.m: Welcome back my friend! Good news. I have successfully distilled the fragments of the claws you brought earlier.

herec_q4.m: Now I am able to create effective potions that contain some essence of the white wyrms. These potions will be very useful in future dealings with these monsters.

herec_q5.m: Would you like to trade for some potions?
r: Sure. Let's see what you have.

bwm_wyrms.10: Herec on the second level of the Blackwater mountain settlement is researching the white wyrms outside the settlement. He wants me to bring him 5 white wyrm claws so that he can continue his research. Apparently, only some of the wyrms have these claws. I will have to kill some to find them.
bwm_wyrms.20: I have given the 5 white wyrm claws to Herec.
bwm_wyrms.30: Herec has finished making a potion of fatigue restoration that will be very useful when fighting against the wyrms in the future.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
